item.title: Portland 2027 Worlds: tickets on sale, and your bucket list
item.description:
The world's best disc golfers will descend on Portland, Oregon, June 16–20, 2027, for five days of championship competition at the PDGA Pro Worlds — and tickets are now on sale, with fans encouraged to start planning their trips. Alongside the announcement, the Disc Golf Pro Tour published a Portland bucket list of things to do around the event, framing Worlds as a destination week rather than just a tournament.

For fans, the practical news is simple: tickets are live and Portland in June is a big trip worth booking early. Worlds is the sport's biggest stage, and the early ticket launch — more than seven months out — signals the DGPT expects strong demand. If you're thinking about going, now is the moment to start planning.

Sources

  • Disc Golf Pro Tour: The Road to Portland Starts Here: 2027 PDGA Pro Worlds Tickets Now on Sale!
  • Disc Golf Pro Tour: Beyond the Fairways: Your Portland Worlds Bucket List

item.title: Infinite Discs' Black Friday week 2: all Innova discs on sale
item.description:
Infinite Discs' month-long Black Friday event is in week two, and this week's featured brand is Innova: every Innova disc on the site is discounted, with the savings applied automatically at checkout.

It's a good window to stock up on the classics — Aviars, Leopards, Eagles — or the workhorse drivers like Destroyers, Wraiths, and Mambas, plus newer molds like the Rollo, Arachnid, and Fox. If you've been eyeing a bag refresh, this is the cheapest week of the month to do it with the sport's biggest manufacturer.

Sources

  • Infinite Discs Blog: Black Friday (All November) Week 2: Innova

item.title: One Last Stop at Cactus Rock: The JomezPro Series Finale Preview
item.description:
The 2026 disc golf season wraps up with the JomezPro Series Finale at Cactus Rock, and the Disc Golf Pro Tour has published its preview of the top storylines and how to watch. The finale is the last stop of the year, the final chance for players to make a statement before the offseason.

Finales carry extra weight: season-long narratives get settled, players fighting for ranking position or momentum have one more event, and the coverage itself is a showcase for the sport's biggest stage. The preview is the place to check start times, broadcast details, and which players and plotlines to follow as the season closes.

Sources

  • Disc Golf Pro Tour: One Last Stop at Cactus Rock! Top Storylines & How to Watch the 2026 JomezPro Series Finale

item.title: 2026 GYROpalooza Mystery Boxes Are Up for Preorder
item.description:
MVP's 2026 GYROpalooza Mystery Box preorders are live at Infinite Discs. Each box includes four Special Edition discs, plus additional discs, and the boxes ship on Black Friday — so preordering now locks in a box before they sell through.

One practical note from Infinite Discs: don't add additional items to a GYROpalooza preorder, because extra items won't ship until the boxes do. GYROpalooza has become one of the disc golf year's biggest gear events, with the mystery format and limited Special Edition runs driving fast sellouts — if you want one, the preorder window is the time to act.

Sources

  • Infinite Discs Blog: 2026 GYROpalooza Mystery Boxes Available for Preorder!
